paper_record.title: Extraordinary Lifetime Enhancement of Coherent Phonon-Amplitude Modes in the Excitonic Insulator Phase of Ta2Pd3Te5
paper_record.abstract: The excitonic insulator (EI) is an electronic phase of condensed excitons. However, in many prototypical materials the presence of a concurrent structural transition complicates the identification of a purely electronic origin of the ordered state. Here, we investigate Ta2Pd3Te5, in which an EI phase develops below TC ~ 100 K in the absence of a detectable structural transition. We characterize the excitonic condensate via its coherent phonon-amplitude response. Most strikingly, an extraordinarily strong lifetime enhancement of these modes sets in below TC which we establish as a new and robust fingerprint linked to exciton condensation. We discuss possibilities to capture the enhancement when taking into account a coupling of excitonic and lattice effects in line with the coupled phonon-amplitude response. Within an order-parameter polaron picture coupling to the excitonic state may dress the phonon mode and thereby suppress its relaxation and a phenomenological model combines the anharmonic phonon response and a reduced electronic scattering due to the gap opening in the EI phase.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 在无结构相变的激子绝缘体 Ta2Pd3Te5 中，观测到了相干声子振幅模式寿命的显著增强，并将其确立为激子凝聚的新特征。
one_sentence_summary.en: Extraordinary lifetime enhancement of coherent phonon-amplitude modes is observed in the excitonic insulator Ta2Pd3Te5, establishing a new fingerprint for exciton condensation in the absence of structural phase transitions.

problem.zh: 在激子绝缘体候选材料中，难以区分电子驱动的激子凝聚与伴随的结构相变，且缺乏明确的实验指纹来表征纯电子起源的激子态。
problem.en: Distinguishing between electronic excitonic insulator states and concurrent structural transitions is difficult, and identifying robust experimental fingerprints for purely electronic exciton condensation remains a challenge.

approach.zh: 利用非简并泵浦-探测反射光谱技术研究 Ta2Pd3Te5 的相干声子动力学，并结合极化子模型与唯象模型分析寿命增强机制。
approach.en: Using non-degenerate pump-probe reflectivity spectroscopy to investigate coherent phonon dynamics in Ta2Pd3Te5, supported by order-parameter polaron and phenomenological models.

main_takeaway.zh: Ta2Pd3Te5 在激子绝缘体相中表现出相干声子模式寿命的异常增强，证明了即使没有宏观结构不稳定性，激子-晶格耦合依然存在。
main_takeaway.en: Ta2Pd3Te5 exhibits an extraordinary enhancement of coherent phonon mode lifetimes in the excitonic insulator phase, demonstrating that strong exciton-lattice coupling persists even without macroscopic structural instability.

why_it_matters.zh: 该研究为激子绝缘体提供了一种新的动力学特征，并表明激子凝聚可以诱导长寿命的相干激发，为研究量子材料中的多体相互作用提供了新平台。
why_it_matters.en: This study provides a new dynamical signature for excitonic insulators and shows that exciton condensation can induce long-lived coherent excitations, offering a new platform for studying many-body interactions.

reason.zh: 该工作在无结构相变的材料中发现了激子凝聚的新动力学指纹，并提出了合理的物理模型解释寿命增强现象。
reason.en: The work identifies a novel dynamical fingerprint of exciton condensation in a material without structural phase transitions and provides plausible physical models to explain the lifetime enhancement.

reason.zh: 该研究涉及量子材料中的激子绝缘体相，具有较高的物理深度和实验创新性，符合顶级物理期刊的定位。
reason.en: The study addresses the excitonic insulator phase in quantum materials with significant physical depth and experimental innovation, fitting the scope of top-tier physics journals.
